text:
maria: Heads-up: PR #482 adds a small 'compat shim' example for Optimize toolkit (SDK migration + quant profile note). Need docs review and a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/482 :mag:
jake: Thanks — tagging @anya for SDK snippet, @kevin for quant profile sanity check. Also we should add a tiny note about cost tradeoffs.
anya: Quick Python snippet for v1->v2 migration (keeps batching/caching minimal):
```py
# old v1-style
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD")
out = client.generate("Summarize the logs")

# v2-style shim (minimal change)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD")
resp = client.text.generate(prompt="Summarize the logs", model="redwood/opt-1")
print(resp.text)
```
Also a short Node snippet: 
```js
// node v2 shim
const { Client } = require('@redwood/inference')
const c = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD })
const r = await c.text.generate({ model: 'redwood/opt-1', prompt: 'Summarize the logs' })
console.log(r.outputText)
```
kevin: Quant profile notes: use `precision` with values like `q8_0` or `q4_0`; recommend `kv_prefetch: true` for chat workloads. For short sequences, watch out for accuracy drift — add a sentence that we fallback to float32 for sequences < 16 tokens in the profile example. I left a line comment on the PR with suggested yaml.
maria: Good call. Also add a one-line cost note: "Quantization can reduce memory and inference cost ~3-4x but may slightly affect token probabilities; test on a held-out prompt set."
docs-bot: label applied: docs/needs-review
jake: I'll drop a short checklist in the PR description and fix the console link to the canonical docs page. Proposed checklist bullets: - update SDK snippet (py/js) - add quant profile example w/ comment about shortseq fallback - include cost note + perf numbers (rough) - add console link + anchor to quant profiles
anya: LGTM on the snippets. One tweak: for Node example prefer `client.batch()` if you want to demonstrate batching; add a micro example of `batch([{prompt:..}, ...])`.
kevin: Added a suggested 'shortseq' profile in the PR comments: `min_seq: 8` and `fallback_precision: float32`. Also suggested `prefetch_policy: 'aggressive'` for streaming chat.
maria: Perfect. Jake — can you also run a quick smoke eval on 10 prompts and paste the delta in PR comments? Even a table like: tokens/cost before vs after.
jake: Yep — I'll run it and push results by EOD. :clock3:
maria: Thanks everyone. Once merged, @docs-bot please crosspost a short blurb to #release-war-room and attach the migration checklist.
docs-bot: will do on merge (will also auto-generate changelog entry).
